title: Catalog reliability and production operations
summary: This release makes public catalogs more reliable and easier to discover, strengthens browser and API security, and adds privacy-safe production activity logging. Signed desktop update packages remain on the existing Preview policy; stable/latest promotion is unchanged.
items: Public MCP and Skill sitemaps cover the full catalog, use content-based lastmod dates, and keep non-indexable React server component payloads out of the crawl.
Authors can add a safe Listed on SourceWeft badge to GitHub READMEs for catalog skills and MCP servers.
Large Skill repositories and GitHub rate limits are handled more reliably, with bounded chunked imports and refresh pauses until quota reset.
Dashboard workspace switches now show progress, recover from transient service errors, and report failures with a retry path.
Web and API responses receive security headers; public legal-page titles and Skill listing cursors are corrected.
Production logs now report privacy-safe chat, authentication, billing, and installation activity, including worker metrics.
